proof_body:
by
  intro a d h k n hk hkn
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a m = a 1 + ((m : ℝ) - 1) * d := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ m hm ih =>
      rw [h m hm, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  have e : ((n + 1 - k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) + 1 - (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [key k hk, key (n + 1 - k) (by omega), key n (by omega), e]
  ring
